hero.title: Cost Platform
hero.description: Replacing SAP Fiori with a unified ReactJS financial platform for 20K+ internal users. Rebuilt 100+ fragmented services into a single scalable product in 6 months.

sections.title: UX Research & Discovery
paragraphs: The project started with extensive user research. Over the course of two years, we collected more than 2,000 feedback messages via biannual surveys. Users consistently reported dissatisfaction with the old SAP Fiori tiled interface, noting that significant time was wasted simply searching for the right financial service.

Our baseline metrics were alarming: an NPS of 54% (with a target of 80%) and a bottom-2 dissatisfaction rate of 25% (target 5%). The clear directive was to unify these fragmented services into a single, cohesive ReactJS platform.

sections.title: Architecture & Navigation Complexity
paragraphs: One of the biggest hurdles was consolidating over 100 distinct financial services—each with its own disparate architecture—into a unified platform. We collaborated closely with business analysts to develop a robust role model, ensuring users only saw services relevant to their specific permissions.
To prevent cognitive overload, we constrained the navigation structure to a maximum of two nesting levels, categorizing the 100+ services into 10 logical groups.

sections.title: Wireframing & Prototyping
paragraphs: Our design strategy combined proven patterns from competitors: minimalist design from modern HR systems, robust category navigation from support portals, and card-based views familiar to Fiori users.

We prepared interactive prototypes of the light theme using Framer and tested them with a control group. Based on their feedback, we increased interface resolution and optimized information density for smaller desktop screens.

sections.title: Design System & Grids
paragraphs: Being the sole designer for a platform of this scale, I adopted Material Design with strategic brand customizations. This allowed developers to build services rapidly without constant design bottlenecks.
Accessibility was a priority: I utilized three adjustment colors from our primary brand color and ensured a minimum contrast ratio of 2.0. Linters were strictly used to maintain layout purity.

sections.title: Relative Web & Mobile Apps
paragraphs: The platform was built on strict principles of relativity using CSS Flexbox and Grid. While the initial focus was on the desktop web platform (2021) since key services operated in the internal domain, we established a clear roadmap for native mobile applications in 2022. Both Light and Dark modes were fully specified.

sections.title: Final Result & Impact
paragraphs: Within six months, we launched the comprehensive platform to production. A follow-up survey conducted on 267 pilot users revealed a drastic improvement in user sentiment. Users praised the significant boost in operational speed, the clean interface, and the overall efficiency of interacting with the financial services.

keyAchievements: Designed scalable navigation max 2 levels deep.
